productSet.title: WARNING ADVERTENCIA Bilingual Work Platform Max Load 1,000 Sign, English and Spanish, Maximum Load 1,000 Lbs, for Warehouses and Plants, 8x12 Premium Extra-Thick Aluminum Sign by CGAP Safety
productSet.descriptionHtml:
Maximum Load 1,000 Lbs. This WARNING ADVERTENCIA sign from CGAP Safety reads: WORK PLATFORM / MAX LOAD 1,000 LBS / PLATAFORMA / 1,000 LIBRAS. Written for warehouses and plants.

Why this sign matters

Gives English and Spanish speaking crews the same rule for the work platform max load 1,000 in one sign, so nobody misses it because of language.

Where to post it

On or next to the work platform.

Who orders it

Warehouse managers and facility managers.

Premium extra-thick, rust-resistant aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. A sign supports your site rules; it does not replace training or supervision.
